fit.preconditioner: Separate uncentered moments; symmetric inverse square root with every eigenvalue floored at1e-8 times its own largest; all64 dimensions retained
fit.optimizer: CPU deterministic full-batch FP64 PyTorch L-BFGS; one persistent history20; strong_wolfe; default lr1; default stopping tolerances disabled

evaluation.primary: CUDA FP32; states@whitener followed by transformed_queries@B then @transformed_candidates.T /8
evaluation.sensitivity: Same operations CUDA FP64, same terminal artifacts; no alternate iterate or fit
evaluation.uniform: Zero score matrix; deterministic lowest-index argmax metrics plus analytic uniform-random accuracy/exact-array expectations separately
evaluation.hard_controls: Self i; original-order [0,0,1,...n-2]; CE/ranks/margins unavailable without scores
evaluation.ties: Lowest candidate index for argmax; retain competition rank and stable index rank
evaluation.common: K=whitened candidates; Q=whitened queries@B; b=Kc@meanQ/8, repeated across queries; analytical component not fitted

bootstrap.generator: Python random.Random(6300), randint/randrange with replacement; identical resamples for both paired contrasts

evaluation.strong: Converged, bothL16 competence thresholds, both paired lower bounds>0; FP64-only recovery flagged fragile

heldout_disclosure: Held out from readout fitting; previously examined in historical studies
